facts.fact: ESCCOM's Cybersecurity Agency, called the National Cybersecurity Agency, is stated to operate nationally, with a Cybersecurity Incident Response Officer and a proof of concept of an incident response and information sharing platform (IRIS); the date 2026-10-05 is inferred by the source's metadata from a Monday event reported on 2026-10-08.

note: The national cyber drill is a drill and gives no response fact.

facts.fact: The Director of Public Prosecutions is stated to be working with a National Cyber Incident Response Team, among others, on cybercrime investigations and prosecutions.

note: Strategy review is stated but adoption is not, so no strategy fact.
Completed ITU CIRT assessment, awaiting legislation; not created or operating.

facts.fact: The World Bank PID states a National Cybersecurity Strategy (2022) was formulated, providing a strategic roadmap, while noting no national CSIRT and no Critical Information Infrastructure framework yet exist.

note: The PID states the absence of a national CSIRT and a CII framework as at 2025-06-28; no aspect value fits that, so no fact.
Regional framework approved by SADC ministers; nothing stated about a national body in Eswatini.
A national cybersecurity centre is only proposed by a vendor director; no strategy, body, alert or figure is stated.
Regional central-bank cybersecurity framework only; no national strategy or body stated.
Awareness month launch speech; no strategy, national body, alert or figure stated.

facts.fact: Prime Minister Dlamini announced that the Eswatini Communications Commission has been formally designated the National Cybersecurity Agency, with a fully operational Cyber Incident Response Team.
The Prime Minister cited the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027 as part of the country's digital defence framework.
ESCCOM's Assistant Director for Cybersecurity says the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 (s.52) designated the Eswatini Communications Commission as the national cybersecurity agency.

note: Incident response function described but no handled incident or alert stated; critical information infrastructure said not yet declared.

facts.fact: The document names Eswatini's National Cybersecurity Agency (NCA) as running a 2024 awareness campaign; it does not state how the agency was created.

ESCCOM, which its chief executive calls the National Cybersecurity Agency, launched investigations into ransomware attacks on public entities including the Eswatini Water Services Corporation, after an alert from its threat intelligence tools.

A Ministry of ICT engineer says the Ministry established the National Cybersecurity Agency at ESCCOM to coordinate all cybersecurity issues, with the National Computer Incident Response Team (NCIRT) established under it.
A Ministry of ICT engineer says Government developed the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027.
Minister Maziya cited Eswatini's National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027 at the Africa Cybersecurity Indaba.
Minister Maziya cited an operational National Computer Incident Response Team as part of the national cybersecurity arrangements.

note: The only line is the national cybersecurity strategy 2022-2027, already in evidence.csv.
Bill on physical critical infrastructure (towers, fibre, energy lines); no national cyber body or designated critical information infrastructure stated.
Regulator MoU on cooperation including incident response; a cooperation memorandum, noted and not a body, response or law.
SOC is only planned; no national body, strategy, response or designation stated.

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa names the Eswatini National Computer Incident Response Team (SzCIRT) as the national response team issuing a security advisory.
SzCIRT issued a high-severity public advisory on the 16 November 2026 Optimjack attack on Optimizely, urging local banks, merchants and government portals to audit their web code.
